title: Photography Museums in Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **Four places, two corners of the city.** Fotografiska is in Mitte; C/O Berlin, the Museum für Fotografie and the Camera Work gallery sit around **Zoologischer Garten**, 9 minutes away on the S-Bahn.
**Fotografiska is the late one:** open **every day 10:00 to 23:00**, last entry 22:00, 15 euros. Two online tickets cost the price of one on Tuesdays from 18:00. Cards only.
**C/O Berlin is open every day 11:00 to 20:00**, 15 euros, and **free up to and including age 18**. Free English tour on Saturdays and Sundays at 15:30.
**The Museum für Fotografie and Helmut Newton Foundation is closed on Mondays** and fully closed from **16 November to 2 December 2026**. 12 euros, until 20:00 on Thursdays.
**Camera Work on Kantstraße is free**, Tuesday to Saturday 11:00 to 18:00.
**Pair C/O Berlin with the Museum für Fotografie:** a 4-minute walk, and each takes **2 euros off** the other's full ticket on the same day.
**My move:** City West in the afternoon from Tuesday to Saturday, Fotografiska after dinner on any day.
